hero.summary: I'm a Cyber Security Engineer with over three years of experience in IT security engineering, security operations and GRC across cloud and enterprise environments, backed by a software engineering background in secure development.

intro.paragraph1: I'm a Cyber Security Engineer with over three years of experience in IT security engineering, security operations, and governance, risk and compliance (GRC) across cloud and enterprise environments.
intro.paragraph2: Currently I work as a Cyber Security Engineer within the DevOps team at Bettermile, where I focus on detecting threats early, managing vulnerabilities end to end, and building security into development workflows rather than adding it afterwards. Before moving into security, I worked as a Software Engineer, which helps me speak the same language as development teams and turn security requirements into practical solutions.

skills.mission: I want to detect threats earlier and build security in from the start, and I'm especially interested in how AI-driven technologies can strengthen cybersecurity.

workExperience.heading: Work Experience
workExperience.description: From software engineering to security engineering, with a focus on practical solutions for development teams.

entries.summary: Security monitoring, incident response and vulnerability management across cloud and enterprise environments, working within the DevOps team.
highlights: Monitor security systems and analyze security events to identify suspicious activity, anomalies and potential threats.
Analyze threat intelligence and attack patterns to identify potential attack vectors and support proactive defense.

Develop and coordinate incident response playbooks and emergency plans, managing incidents through investigation, escalation, documentation and post-incident improvements, aligned with NIS2 reporting requirements.
Manage the vulnerability lifecycle by identifying, prioritizing and coordinating remediation, and validating corrective actions.
Develop automation scripts for recurring security tasks, detection processes and operational workflows.
Work with AWS security architecture, secure configurations and cloud-based security monitoring.
Conduct structured risk analyses to assess technical and business impact and define appropriate measures.
Conduct internal audits and support external audits.

entries.summary: Day-to-day IT security and administration across enterprise environments, from endpoints and identity to networks.
highlights: Administered IT security infrastructure including endpoint protection, firewalls, network security devices and monitoring tools.
Performed system hardening and security baseline management across Windows Server and Linux environments.
Managed identity and access, including Active Directory, user lifecycle management, RBAC and MFA enforcement.
Managed network security including firewall administration, network segmentation and VPN configuration.
Supported security monitoring, incident investigations and technical documentation, coordinating remediation with infrastructure teams.

entries.summary: Supported the implementation of an ISO 27001-compliant ISMS aligned with BSI IT-Grundschutz and GDPR requirements.
highlights: Contributed to internal and external audit preparation and security status reporting.
Helped create and maintain security policies, procedures and compliance documentation.
Supported responses to security questionnaires and compliance inquiries.

entries.summary: Built web applications and backend services with secure development practices and automated security testing.
highlights: Tested applications using OWASP practices and Burp Suite, including static testing, dynamic testing and code reviews.
Implemented secure coding practices aligned with OWASP guidelines to reduce application vulnerabilities.
Integrated security controls into CI/CD pipelines to support automated security testing.
Developed automation scripts and tooling for secure deployment and infrastructure configuration.
Identified application vulnerabilities and coordinated fixes with development teams.
Supported API and data security, including authentication controls, input validation and protection of sensitive data.

items.title: NIST CSF 2.0 Implementation
items.description: Designed and implemented a cybersecurity framework based on NIST CSF 2.0 for a Microsoft-based enterprise environment, covering security governance, risk assessment, identity and access management, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, security monitoring and incident response.
features: Mapping Across All Six CSF Functions
Current & Target Profiles with Gap Analysis

developmentDetails.label: Framework Mapping
developmentDetails.text: Mapped NIST CSF 2.0 requirements across the six functions: Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover.

developmentDetails.label: Risk & Gap Analysis
developmentDetails.text: Developed a cybersecurity risk register, asset inventory, current and target security profiles, and a gap analysis to identify security weaknesses and prioritize remediation.

developmentDetails.label: Technical Controls
developmentDetails.text: Implemented security controls with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Defender and Sentinel, and designed identity and access controls including MFA, Conditional Access, least privilege and privileged access reviews.

developmentDetails.label: Vulnerability & Incident Handling
developmentDetails.text: Developed workflows for identifying, prioritizing, tracking and validating security findings, and established security monitoring, incident response procedures and recovery practices aligned with NIST CSF.

developmentDetails.label: Governance & Reporting
developmentDetails.text: Created a security control register, implementation roadmap, evidence repository and KPI dashboard to monitor security posture and control effectiveness, supported by policies and procedures for access control, vulnerability management, incident management, business continuity, risk management, supplier security and security awareness.
